dataset_meta.name: Comprehensive Fundamental Data
dataset_meta.probe_method: WorldQuant BRAIN BrainApiClient.get_datafields(region=GLB, universe=MINVOL1M, delay=1, dataset_id=fundamental72, filter_sharpe=false), full 896 fields

profile_methodology.authored_by: quant research analyst, handwritten DGP classification (no Python source modified, no formula generated)

domain_classes.[0, inf): non-negative financial statement level amounts (assets, liabilities, revenue, cash, share counts) - right skewed, scale-bound
domain_classes.[0, 1]: ratios / rates / percentages (discount rate, payout, effective tax rate, proportions)
domain_classes.(-inf, inf): signed net amounts, P&L results, period changes, adjustments, per-share values - can be negative
domain_classes.[0, inf) integer ordinal: non-negative integer counts and date/period ordinals (entry date, fiscal quarter, number of branches)

profile_methodology.physical_bucket_keys: type x domain x is_sparse x skewness (anti_laziness grid)
profile_methodology.note: domain is a physical-semantic declaration, not a measured sample range; coverage/userCount/alphaCount are measured.
profile_methodology.domain_review: 39 ratio-domain candidates were manually reviewed; EPS/per-share/pre-tax-income/operating-income/operating-cash-flow/adjustment fields reclassified to (-inf, inf); discontinued-operations revenue to [0, inf). Only genuine rates/proportions remain [0, 1].
